title: Make a page answer-ready
author: TriunaLabs
origin: Original TriunaLabs workflow derived from a user-selected landing-page concept, then revised against current primary guidance to emphasize people-first content, visible evidence, semantic access, and honest limits.
requirements: Python 3.10+ for deterministic local or URL audits. URL input requires network access. Editing, browser validation, Search Console, and external structured-data tests depend on the tools and authorization available in the host environment.
examples: Audit this product page and generate an interactive answer-readiness report with a claim ledger and prioritized fixes.
Improve this consulting landing page without changing its design system; make the offer, proof, structured data, and next action clearer.
Create an evidence-backed landing page for this open-source tool using only the supplied repository facts and benchmarks.

preview.alt: Answer-ready web audit showing a readiness score, evidence coverage, page structure, claim ledger, and prioritized improvements.
